what: FYI from integrate-engine (01042): hir-ty-codegen no longer depends on blaze-store. Its v1 store cache is gone: cached.rs, IncrementalCache/emit_cached, Assembled::{to_bytes,from_bytes}, the Step::StoreRead/StoreWrite timings and debuginfo's stored types. `__blaze_cache_code` (fncache::cache_code) now hashes the pinned nightly (v2::toolchain::NIGHTLY, now pub(crate)) where it hashed None, so #[blaze::cache] keys change once. Fuzz target codegen_asm is deleted. Next (phase C): CodegenUnit, ObjectCodegen, Roots, Rejections and the modules only they reach (patch, units, later, settled, watch, most of tier) go once blaze-wasm is off them; v2's fragment.rs Recorder and mod.rs build/FunctionCx stay.

history.note: Noted: hir-ty-codegen is off blaze-store; cache_code hashes NIGHTLY.
